criteria.criterion: The skill writes .vloop/tmp/verify.json as verify/v2 and validates it with `vloop schema validate verify/v2 .vloop/tmp/verify.json` as soon as it has read the brief and again after pass 1, pass 2 and pass 3, each time with every finding, count and line not run so far; `complete` is false in every write but the last, which sets it true, and `notes` says which passes remain while it is false.
criteria.evidence: New 'Write the report early' section in SKILL.md; validation command kept in section 5.

criteria.criterion: A worked-example line is not run when the brief keeps it for the operator's acceptance, when its command is one the verify fence denies (the skill names at least `vloop init`, `vloop run`, `vloop brief review`, `vloop brief close` and `claude`), when it needs a live model (Claude or Copilot), the network or credentials, or when a command it needs was denied. Each is one `not_run` entry: `line` quoted as the brief writes it, `reason` in a few words (the denied rule, `needs a live model`, `the operator's, at close`, `covered by <test>`).
criteria.evidence: Added 'not run' paragraph in pass 1 and not_run explanation in section 5 name all listed commands and reasons.

criteria.criterion: The skill does not retry a denied command in another form (the denial goes into the reason), does not count a line not run in `example_lines`, and does not make it a finding — any of these is a violation.
criteria.evidence: Pass 1 paragraph: 'Do not retry a denied command in another form... not counted in example_lines and is not a finding.'

criteria.criterion: Scratch set-up is one command per tool call; a scratch repository is made with `git init -q <dir>`, never `git -C <dir> init` and never chained after `mkdir`. Each command's output is cut to what the session needs (through `head` or `tail`).
criteria.evidence: Section 2 rewritten with `git init -q <scratch>/ex1`, no chaining, one command per call, head/tail.

criteria.criterion: The skill's report example is a valid verify/v2 report with one `not_run` entry; every mention of verify/v1 in the skill (its description included) becomes verify/v2; the skill cites no `fence/` path.
criteria.evidence: Example has schema verify/v2, complete, one not_run entry; grep finds no v1 or fence/ in the file; skills test passes in go check log.
